integrity: All-parameter claim proved using exact row-sum quadratic identity and spectral variational principle; finite verifier is illustrative, not a general proof.
scientific_limitations: At least three equal-sized groups; positive peripheral row totals; one dominant row total at least the sum of all other totals. Controls reproduction spectral radius only, not epidemic final size or stochastic extinction; potential unindexed spectral optimization overlap remains.
title: Unique hub-star minimum for reversible multigroup epidemic risk
